name: repertorium
description: Read-only research in Polish and EU law: statutes, case law and a citation graph, with a source and a locator for every result.

capabilities: Read statutes and judgments with character-level locators
Find court rulings that cite a provision
Check case numbers, dates and provisions cited in a draft
Amendment history of Polish statutory provisions
Links between Polish acts and EU law
defaultPrompt: What does Article 415 of the Polish Civil Code say? Quote it with the source.
Check this citation: I ACa 1224/14, Court of Appeal in Łódź, 20 March 2015.
When was Article 94³ of the Polish Labour Code amended, and by which acts?

positive.description: Read a statutory provision with its source. The plugin finds the current consolidated text of the Polish Civil Code and returns the passage of Article 415 with a document identifier, a locator and a link to the official source.
positive.prompt: What does Article 415 of the Polish Civil Code say? Quote it and give the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the consolidated text of the Polish Civil Code (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 795, document eli:DU/2026/795) with the passage of Article 415: "Kto z winy swej wyrządził drugiemu szkodę, obowiązany jest do jej naprawienia" (whoever culpably causes damage to another is obliged to redress it), and a source link to api.sejm.gov.pl. The answer quotes the article and names the source; it may also list court rulings that discuss Article 415.

positive.description: Citation graph for a provision. The plugin lists Polish court rulings that cite Article 415 of the Civil Code and says that the list is partial.
positive.prompt: Find Polish court rulings that cite Article 415 of the Polish Civil Code.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Polish court rulings citing Article 415, each with a document identifier and a locator pointing at the citing passage. The response marks the list as partial (completeness.floor is true and the total is not known), so the answer does not present it as complete and does not state a total number of rulings.

positive.description: Check a citation from a draft brief. The case number exists in the corpus, but the date given in the draft does not match it.
positive.prompt: Check this citation from my draft: judgment of the Court of Appeal in Łódź of 20 March 2015, case no. I ACa 1224/14.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that case I ACa 1224/14 is in the corpus (Court of Appeal in Łódź, document saos:127095), but its date in the corpus is 5 December 2014, so the citation is flagged with date_mismatch. The answer points out the date discrepancy instead of confirming the citation. If the model also opens the judgment text, it may note that the text itself gives 21 November 2014; either way, the date in the draft (20 March 2015) does not match.

positive.description: Amendment history of a provision. The plugin lists the known amendments of Article 94³ of the Polish Labour Code (workplace bullying) with dates and amending acts.
positive.prompt: When was Article 94³ of the Polish Labour Code amended, and by which acts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three known changes to Article 94³ of the Labour Code (eli:DU/1974/141): added with effect from 1 January 2004 (Dz.U. 2003 poz. 2081), amended with effect from 7 September 2019 (Dz.U. 2019 poz. 1043) and amended by Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1046 with a computed entry-into-force date of 5 November 2026. The answer says these are known amendment points, not the historical wording of the article.

positive.description: European Court of Human Rights judgment by application number. The plugin identifies the case and returns links to the Polish translation and to HUDOC without reproducing the translated text.
positive.prompt: Is there a Polish translation of the ECHR judgment in application no. 37359/09? Give me the links.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Hämäläinen v. Finland, judgment of 16 July 2014, and returns a link to the Polish translation on the Ministry of Justice portal (etpcz.ms.gov.pl) and a HUDOC link. The translation is flagged with a copyright notice, so the answer links to it rather than reproducing its text.

negative.description: Case number not in the corpus. The plugin must not invent a judgment: the tool reports the case number as not_in_corpus with an empty result list. Expected answer: the judgment is not in the Repertorium corpus, which does not prove that it does not exist, and no summary is produced.
negative.prompt: Summarise the Polish Supreme Court judgment II CSK 999/99.

negative.description: Non-existent provision cited in a draft. The Polish Civil Code has no Article 2150; after checking the consolidated text, verify_citations returns provision_not_found. Expected answer: the article does not exist in the current consolidated text of the Code, and no wording is produced or invented.
negative.prompt: Check this citation from my draft and quote the provision: Article 2150 of the Polish Civil Code.

negative.description: Domestic case that must not be treated as a European Court of Human Rights case. Polish civil case titles also use the word 'przeciwko' (against). The plugin returns Polish court rulings and no ECHR or HUDOC links. Expected answer: the case is presented as a Polish domestic dispute, not as an ECHR case.
negative.prompt: Find the case "Gmina Kraków przeciwko Skarbowi Państwa o zapłatę".

review.commerce_description: Repertorium does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: eight read-only tools for Polish and EU law - search, documents, citation graph, citation check, amendment history, EU origin of Polish acts, relations between acts and corpus coverage.
